meta.title: Comprehensive Psychiatric Diagnostic Reference
meta.description: A comprehensive guide to organic, neuropsychiatric, and systemic causes of psychiatric presentations using the Rule of Two

conditions.name: Alzheimer's Disease (Early Onset)
investigations: CSF biomarkers (decreased Aβ42, increased phosphorylated tau)

conditions.name: Frontotemporal Dementia (Behavioral Variant)
investigations: MRI brain (frontal and/or anterior temporal atrophy)

conditions.name: Primary Progressive Aphasia (Nonfluent Variant)
investigations: MRI brain (left posterior frontal and insular atrophy)

conditions.name: Huntington's Disease
investigations: Genetic testing (HTT gene CAG repeat expansion ≥36)

conditions.name: Multiple System Atrophy (Parkinsonian Type)
investigations: MRI brain (putaminal atrophy, hot cross bun sign)

conditions.name: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (Sporadic)
investigations: MRI brain (DWI/FLAIR cortical and basal ganglia hyperintensities)

conditions.name: CADASIL
investigations: MRI brain (temporal pole white matter changes)

conditions.name: Tuberculous Meningitis
investigations: CSF PCR for TB, MRI brain

conditions.name: Manganese Poisoning
investigations: MRI brain (T1 hyperintensity in basal ganglia)

conditions.name: REM Sleep Behavior Disorder
signs: Absence of muscle atonia during REM

conditions.name: Dissociative Amnesia
signs: Cannot be explained by other conditions

conditions.name: Personality Disorder (Cluster B)
signs: Antisocial, borderline, histrionic, or narcissistic traits
